To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a generic model that learns distributed representations of text and entities from knowledge bases.
we have developed a novel neural network model that learns distributed representations of text and entities from knowledge base.

we propose a novel neural network model that can learn distributed representations of texts (i.e., sentences) and entities from the knowledge base, we train our model using a large dataset extracted from Wikipedia, we evaluate the model on three different tasks (i.e. sentence similarity, entity linking and factoid question-answering) and we achieve state-of-the-art performance in all of these three tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of learning distributed representations of texts, and we believe our proposed model can serve as a strong baseline for future research in this area.

the following question: how can we jointly learn representations of texts and KB entities from large corpora of unstructured texts? We believe this work will be useful for many applications that involve text understanding.

the following question: How can we learn distributed representations of texts (e.g., sentences and paragraphs) and entities from a large corpus of text and their entity annotations in the knowledge base (KB)?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed model is able to jointly learn the distributed representation for texts and KB entities.
our proposed model outperforms all previous models on all the three tasks.
the model proposed in the paper is a generic model which learns distributed representations of text and knowledge base entities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a model to jointly represent texts and entities from the knowledge base.
we have developed a generic neural network model to learn distributed representations of texts as well as knowledge base entities.
our model can be used to learn distributed representations of texts as well as entities, and can also be applied to a number of NLP tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can learn distributed representation of texts and entities jointly from large corpus of texts.
the model can jointly learn the distributed representation of texts and entities from a KB.
we can learn generic and effective representations for texts and KB entities by jointly training on a large corpus of text-annotated KB data.
